Aimbot、Triggerbot 和 Rage 共用此设置。敌人和队友可独立选: Aimbot, Triggerbot and Rage share this setting. Select enemies and teammates independently. Only enemies are included by default. Turn both off to leave all three features without targets.
开启后队友也可成为目标。Rage 按可对队友造成伤害的条件估算，实际伤害由服务器: Includes teammates as possible targets. Rage estimates damage assuming teammates can take damage. Actual damage depends on the server’s friendly-fire rules.
Aimbot 和 Rage 共用此换算。: Aimbot and Rage share this input mapping.
Aimbot与Rage共用控制采样年龄、执行延迟及速度预测设置。: Aimbot and Rage share control sample age, execution delay and velocity prediction settings.
Aimbot与Rage共用鼠标移动方式和速度档位。: Aimbot and Rage share the mouse movement method and speed preset.
Aimbot与Rage共用版本、对照组、方向参考及后坐补偿设置。: Aimbot and Rage share the version, comparison mode, direction reference and recoil compensation settings.
原生数据与纯求值在此查看。后座方案、时序和输入换算在 Aim 常规。鼠标移动、选: Native data and evaluations appear here. Recoil scheme, timing, and input mapping are in Aim General. Mouse movement, target, and side-button settings are in Aimbot.
移动轨迹描述几何路径，速度变化控制决定每步的推进节奏。: Trajectory defines the geometric path; speed control determines how each step advances.
Aimbot 与 Rage 共用移动轨迹、速度变化控制和速度档位。: Aimbot and Rage share the trajectory, speed control, and speed preset.
直线朝目标推进。贝塞尔曲线由起点、终点和两个控制点决定；速度变化控制单独决定沿路: A straight line moves toward the target. A cubic Bezier path uses two control points between its endpoints. Speed control independently sets the pace along that path.
0–100%。沿起点到终点方向的位置，按两点距离计算。控制点只塑造曲线，不要求经: 0–100% of the start-to-end distance along that direction. A control point shapes the curve; the path need not pass through it.
-100–100%。垂直于起点到终点方向的偏移；正负值决定弯曲方向。两个偏移同号: -100–100% of the chord distance, perpendicular to it. Matching signs create an arch; opposite signs can create an S shape. Two zero offsets give a straight line.
使用已核验的原生 P/U 后坐计算。目标选择、移动轨迹和速度变化控制在各自模块处: Evaluates the verified native P/U recoil model. Targeting, trajectory, and speed control are separate modules.
使用 Reader 提供并通过当前资格校验的原生发射方向，后坐相关量随该参考求值: Uses the qualified native firing direction from Reader, with recoil evaluated against that reference.
使用后坐基准角、基准角速度及 tick/fraction，在本批原生模拟时间上按: Evaluates the frozen E function at this sample’s native simulation time using recoil base angles, velocities, and tick/fraction, including native decay, integration, interpolation, and scaling.
使用已读取的不可预测后坐基准与时间求值，再与 P 相加。外推采用已经收到的射击或: Evaluates the received unpredictable recoil base and timing, then adds it to P. Extrapolation uses only impulses already received.
在已核验的本批模拟时间上求出 P/U，执行时刻的外推采用 Aim 常规中的时序设: Evaluates P/U at the verified simulation time. Execution-time extrapolation uses the timing settings in Aim General.
使用当前已核验的原生发射参考及后坐字段，完整来源与时间资格由原生运行时核验。: Uses the verified native firing reference and recoil fields, with complete source and timing validation in the native runtime.
根据当前剩余误差、速度上限、加减速与停止距离调整速度，继续使用设备限制及已启用的: Adjusts speed using remaining error, speed caps, acceleration, braking, and stopping distance. Device limits and enabled learned limits still apply.
对已经求出的后坐变化优先分配速度预算，其他剩余误差保持平滑加减速。首次或时间不连: Prioritizes evaluated recoil changes within the speed budget, then smoothly advances the remaining error. Discontinuous timing resets the differential baseline; unqualified deltas use smooth control.
按当前完整剩余误差直接生成计数，保留速度、学习模型速度上限和设备预算。: Quantizes the current remaining error directly while retaining speed caps, learned speed limits, and device budgets.
保留当前PUBG的轨迹规划、目标跟踪与平滑计数规则；仅拆分移动模块，原有数值不变: Uses PUBG’s existing acceleration, braking, jerk, and target tracking controls. The chosen geometry is applied separately.
移动轨迹、速度变化控制、跟随速度和后坐补偿沿用 Aimbot 的设置。后座方案、: Rage uses Aimbot settings for trajectory, speed control, follow speed, and recoil compensation. Recoil scheme, velocity prediction, estimated execution delay, maximum control sample age, and mouse count mapping are configured in Aim General. Rage also uses the enabled mouse motion model. Rage selects targets and aim points by threat and damage, and runs without holding a side button.
